playstyle.identity: Fizz is a slippery assassin who can't be targeted during his E. He excels at bursting squishies and dodging key abilities with his playful-trickster pole.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive ignores unit collision and reduces auto damage taken. Q dashes through target applying on-hit. W empowers autos with bleed. E hops on pole (untargetable), can hop again or slam down. R throws fish that attaches and summons shark. R-Q-W-E for burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Fizz spikes at level 6 with his shark ultimate. Hextech Rocketbelt adds engage. He's strong at picks and all-ins mid-game.

passive.name: Nimble Fighter
passive.summary: Ignore unit collision and take reduced auto attack damage.
passive.details: Fizz can walk through units and takes reduced damage from auto attacks.

abilities.name: Urchin Strike
abilities.summary: Dash through a target, dealing damage and applying on-hit effects.
abilities.details: Fizz dashes through a target enemy, dealing magic damage and applying on-hit effects. Always travels a fixed distance.

abilities.name: Seastone Trident
abilities.summary: Passive: autos bleed. Active: empower next auto for burst damage.
abilities.details: Passive: Auto attacks deal bonus damage over time. Active: Fizz empowers his next auto attack to deal bonus damage, increased if target is bleeding.

abilities.name: Playful / Trickster
abilities.summary: Hop on pole becoming untargetable; hop again or slam down for damage.
abilities.details: Fizz hops on his trident, becoming untargetable. Recast to hop to a location, or wait to slam down dealing AoE damage and slowing.

abilities.name: Chum the Waters
abilities.summary: Throw a fish that attaches and summons a shark to knock up and damage.
abilities.details: Fizz throws a fish that attaches to the first champion hit (or drops to the ground). After a delay, a shark erupts, knocking up the target and dealing massive damage. Size increases with distance.
